title: Types of Insurance
claims: CDI publishes consumer information organized by line of insurance, including Automobile, Health, Homeowner/Residential, Home Protection Contracts, Life & Annuity, Long-Term Care, Medicare Supplement, Pet, TNC Ride-hailing, and Workers' Compensation.
The page also carries an Information Guides entry alongside the line categories.
updateCadence: Guides are revised periodically by CDI.
